profile: classification accuracy: a measure, denoted A, for a trained model. It is the percentage of the training dataset whose labels are correctly predicted by the model. This measure gives a simple way to quantify how well the model's predicted labels match the true labels on the training data. Accuracy is expressed as a percentage.
